extracted.intended_audience: undergraduate students interested in creative writing / short fiction
extracted.subtask_description: An undergraduate introductory course in the short story where students write original short stories and descriptive sketches, read canonical short fiction, and discuss works (including classmates') in their historical and social contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write stories and short descriptive sketches
rubrics_metrics.description: Students will write stories and short descriptive sketches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Read great short stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Students will read great short stories assigned in the course.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participate in class discussions in historical and social contexts
rubrics_metrics.description: Students will participate in class discussions of students’ writing and the assigned stories in their historical and social contexts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage with peers' work and the assigned readings, considering the stories' historical and social backgrounds as part of discussion and critique.
